Ex 3 · SB p. 88

Put it in order! 🔢

🎯 Tap the lines in order — then listen and check!
·Here are your tickets.
·Here you are.
·Thanks.
·Can I help you?
·That's twelve pounds sixty, please.
·Can I have three tickets to the aquarium, please?

Order: Can I help you? → three tickets → twelve pounds sixty → here you are → your tickets → thanks!
